svg.title: Connected surveillance — animated network
svg.desc: Two blue security cameras connect to stacked recording servers, a network switch and a cloud. Cyan packets travel along fixed cables, camera light fields sweep slowly, and network status indicators glow independently. A self-contained vector illustration with a reduced-motion alternative.
svg.metadata: Original vector reconstruction of the supplied reference. 1648 × 928. All scene components are editable paths. Motion uses SVG animateMotion and CSS, with no scripts or external dependencies.
